newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Aeroflot begins flights between Moscow and Faro.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot begins flights between Moscow and Faro.

text.p: Russian state airline Aeroflot said it would begin operating weekly flights between Moscow and Faro, a holiday destination in the Algarve region of southern Portugal, on June 13.
Aeroflot's Lisbon director Viktor Kirievski told Reuters that the inaugural flight would arrive in Faro on Friday afternoon, and the return flight to Moscow would depart the same afternoon.
The weekly Friday flights will use 189-seat Airbus A-310 aircraft, and are scheduled to run through September, and beyond if there is sufficient demand, Kirievski said.
He added that Aeroflot had added Faro as a destination when it discovered last summer that most passengers on its flights to Lisbon were travelling on to the Algarve.
At present Aeroflot operates two weekly flights to Lisbon.
